evidence.finding: No approved, supplier-verified inbound India package inventory or pricing was supplied for this page.
evidence.limitation: The route concepts are planning prompts, not active or bookable packages and not evidence of supplier availability.
evidence.pagePolicy: Keep one English India planning hub and three genuinely localized market guides for Germany, France and the Netherlands. Do not index route concepts as product pages until distinct content, current supplier arrangements, price terms and operational details are verified.
